recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-14136 unless the work group later wants a separate editorial cleanup of duplicated examples outside this issue's resolved scope.
issue_request: FHIR-14136 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 MnM request to elevate generic guidance from the Observation notes section on using codes for result values into the CodeableConcept datatype, while leaving Observation-specific portions local after editorial review.
initial_application: The likely application is git commit 9748943984c4a8507267d67945dd31c6aae2c6fc. Its subject appears to mistype the tracker as GF#141436, but the patch adds guidance on text-only and translation use for CodeableConcept to source/datatypes.html, matching FHIR-14136. Exact git-log grep for FHIR-14136 found no other direct source commit.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps both datatypes and Observation in build scope. The current CodeableConcept source has Multiple Codings and Using Text in CodeableConcept sections, including the qualitative laboratory value example and text-only example. Later related source history preserved and strengthened this location: FHIR-19431 renamed Observation's local translation wording to additional codings, FHIR-38981 clarified CodeableConcept.text when userSelected is present, and FHIR-50188 expanded multiple-coding safety guidance. Exact Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The requested datatype-level guidance is already present, and the remaining Observation notes are scoped to Observation.value examples with a link back to CodeableConcept, so removing or duplicating them would be unnecessary editorial churn.
